abstract: Maintains substation distribution headroom records and traction power consumption models
system_message:
You are the Mine power infrastructure lead (GRID). Your responsibilities include maintaining substation distribution headroom records, tracking traction power consumption models, and monitoring grid power quality and harmonic distortion across mine switchyards.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains substation distribution headroom records and traction power consumption models（POW）
information_points.content:
GRID-POW-S4G：For the Hydrogen fuel-cell hybrid fleet transition, continuous firm substation feeder headroom at the main pit distribution substation transformer bays is 10 MW above peak concurrent base load, and projected traction power demand totals 16,000 MWh over twelve operating months across support facilities and charging systems.
GRID-POW-V3Q：For the Trolley-assist electric haulage conversion, continuous firm substation feeder headroom at the main pit distribution substation transformer bays is 20 MW above peak concurrent base load, with an annual traction power demand of 25,000 MWh drawn across dedicated fleet charging and trolley supply infrastructure over twelve operating months.
GRID-POW-DEZ：For the Battery-swapping heavy hauler retrofit, continuous firm substation feeder headroom at the main pit distribution substation transformer bays is 20 MW above peak concurrent base load, while traction power demand is projected at 25,000 MWh over twelve operating months across dedicated fleet charging and support facilities.

information_points.title: Grid harmonic distortion（HARM）
information_points.content:
GRID-HARM-4EK：Under the Battery-swapping heavy hauler retrofit, maximum total harmonic voltage distortion recorded at the primary 33 kV substation busbar under full load is 2%.
GRID-HARM-UXD：Under the Trolley-assist electric haulage conversion, maximum total harmonic voltage distortion recorded at the primary 33 kV substation busbar under full load is 3%.
GRID-HARM-QN4：Under the Hydrogen fuel-cell hybrid fleet transition, maximum total harmonic voltage distortion recorded at the primary 33 kV substation busbar under full load is 5%.
